research_findings: The waitlist signup action was missing rate limiting, making it vulnerable to abuse or heavy traffic.
The Upstash Redis and Ratelimit packages were added to implement sliding window rate limiting.
features_improved: The waitlist signup feature in `src/app/actions/waitlist.ts` was refactored to include rate limiting.
new_features_added: Added Upstash Redis and Ratelimit implementation in `src/lib/ratelimit.ts` to limit requests by IP.
next_steps_for_next_run: Expand rate limiting to other sensitive endpoints like authentication or API routes.
